cases: TC-1 · REQ-1, REQ-2, AC-1 weighted GPA, half-even down: (3.7*3+3.3*3+2.0*2)/8=25/8=3.125 ties, even digit 2, to 3.12 · calculateGpa({"courses":[{"gradePoints":"3.7","credits":"3"},{"gradePoints":"3.3","credits":"3"},{"gradePoints":"2.0","credits":"2"}]}) → {"gpa":"3.12"}

TC-2 · REQ-2, REQ-3, AC-2 exact decimal half-even up, not binary float: (4.0+3.0+2.0+1.7)/4=2.675 ties, even digit 8, to 2.68 (2.67 fails) · calculateGpa({"courses":[{"gradePoints":"4.0","credits":"1"},{"gradePoints":"3.0","credits":"1"},{"gradePoints":"2.0","credits":"1"},{"gradePoints":"1.7","credits":"1"}]}) → {"gpa":"2.68"}

TC-3 · REQ-2 closest above halfway 3.125: 2.001 is one 0.001 step above 2.0, quotient moves by 0.00025, (11.1+9.9+4.002)/8=25.002/8=3.12525 nearer 3.13 · calculateGpa({"courses":[{"gradePoints":"3.7","credits":"3"},{"gradePoints":"3.3","credits":"3"},{"gradePoints":"2.001","credits":"2"}]}) → {"gpa":"3.13"}

TC-4 · REQ-2 closest below halfway 2.675: 0.199 is one 0.001 step below tie value 0.200, quotient moves by 0.00025, (3.5*3+0.199)/4=10.699/4=2.67475 nearer 2.67 · calculateGpa({"courses":[{"gradePoints":"3.5","credits":"3"},{"gradePoints":"0.199","credits":"1"}]}) → {"gpa":"2.67"}
TC-5 · REQ-4, AC-3 empty list, no division, not 0.00, not an error · calculateGpa({"courses":[]}) → {"gpa":null}

TC-6 · REQ-4 zero total credits, non-empty, forms "0" and "0.0", not 0.00, not an error · calculateGpa({"courses":[{"gradePoints":"4","credits":"0"},{"gradePoints":"1.5","credits":"0.0"}]}) → {"gpa":null}
